record.reason: Recursive Inference Machines combine a neural backbone with an explicit recursive inference scheme and report gains on ARC-AGI and Sudoku tasks. The paper does not establish lower compute, latency, or memory than its baselines; it is a possible reasoning-inference architecture connection, but efficiency relevance is unproven.
record.title: Recursive Inference Machines for Neural Reasoning
